en:
His name is Kanai-san. I'd like to have a word with him, if
that's all right?
Kanai? Hm... I figured as much.

Only two groups of people know Kanai is our executive
director.

One is Ousaka Enterprises employees. And the other is the
prefectural police organized crime division.
(That sneaky detective... I bet he knew this would happen.)

It doesn't look like I'm getting anywhere here. This calls
for some gentle persuasion.
Do ya know what this place is for?

Well, if I had to guess, I'd say it's an industrial waste
disposal facility, for the real nasty stuff that's left untreated.
Well, if ya know that much, then there's only one thing left to do.
We're gonna have to add you to the scrap heap!
All right. Now I expect you to keep your word.
Sure. Ask me anything.
Are you familiar with Park-san of Dyna Chair?
Yeah. That's the president of Haruka's agency, ain't it?
Did you forge her suicide note?
...I did.
Who asked you to do it?

I never ask their names. It's the number one rule of this
business, so I'm afraid I don't know.
What did he look like?

Guy was massive⑬like a wrestler. Quite a bit bigger'n you.
I'm guessin' he was a yakuza.
That could be the guy I fought outside the agency.
It was an urgent request, the night Park-san died.

He wanted me to forge the note and make it look like the
handwriting in her notebook.

I imagine, by the time he'd asked me... she was already
dead.
I want to see this guy. Where can I find him?
I don't know anythin' more than what I just told ya.
I don't even know if I'll ever see him again.
That makes it a dead end...
Although I did see him once before, in town.

He was drivin' a car, and there was another man ridin' in
the back. That's gotta be his boss.
Okay, but how is that going to help us?
Patience. I'm getting to it.
The guy in the back... I see him a lot on TV these days.

Naoki Katsuya, the very successful president of Osaka
Talent.
Osaka Talent!?
They're one of Dyna Chair's rivals...

Naoki Katsuya of Osaka Talent. So he's the one who had
Park-san killed?
I don't know anythin' more.
What you told us was extremely helpful. Thank you.

Haruka-chan, you make sure you're on that stage for the
Princess League finals, all right?

When I was younger, I was a huge fan of your president,
Park-san.
A fan of Park-san's?
Heh. You know, I see a lotta fakes in my line of work...
I've come to be able to spot them right away.
Fake smiles, fake stories, even fake people.

Nothin' but fakes everywhere I turn. And practically
everything I see on TV nowadays is manufactured, too.

But every once in a while, I see folks who are genuine⑬real
people, just tryin' to be themselves, livin' earnestly.
My heart soars when I see that!
Mr. Forger...
When Park-san and Haruka-chan smile, it's from the heart.
It's those kinds of smiles that keep people goin'.

And so, I wish you the very best of luck, Haruka-chan! You
were meant to keep Park-san's dream alive.
Know that I'll be watching for that smile of yours.
Is everything all right, Akiyama-san?

The forger is in the apartment upstairs. As it turns out,
he's the bartender's father.
His father? I see... Hello, sir.
What did you want me to do?

We're going up to see the forger now. Just come with me.
You'll see.

You're a stranger here, ain't ya? How'd you find this little
hole in the wall?
Oh, I don't know. It's a nice little place. Good atmosphere.
Hmph. So, what'll it be?
Well, let's see. How about... a forged suicide note?

I'm afraid we only serve drinks here, pal. I think you've
made a mistake.
A forger in Kamurocho sent me. Here's my card.
Sorry. We're just about to close. Time to go.
Friendly one, aren't you...?

(Tomorrow is the final round of the Princess League. I'd
better get some sleep.)
(I think I'll stay up a little longer.)
(Okay, time for bed.)
Did you find the forger?
I found him, but I need your help.
Me? What do you want me to do?

Look, I'll explain later. Can you meet me at the Crest Bar
in Hoganji Yokocho? Come quick.
That was the bar the Kamurocho forger told you about, right?
Right. I'll be waiting there.
Okay. I'll leave right now.
Crab is delicious!
(All right. What now?)

(If Katsuya is pulling the strings, it's not like he's going
to let me peek behind the curtain.)

(I guess if I want to get anything done, I'm going to have
to find Ogita.)
Is this Akiyama-san?
Who's this?
I'd like to talk to you about Park-san's suicide.
Could you come back to your Sky Finance office?
I don't believe you answered my question.
Just know that I'm not your enemy.
Who do I have to deal with this time?

Please fill in your name, the time of your appointment, and
the name of the person you are scheduled to meet here.

I don't have an appointment, but I'd like to see the
president.
I want to talk to him about the murder of Mirei Park.
One moment, please.
Appreciate it.

Haruka-chan... You're getting a big, long lecture from me
later for going off and trying to settle things on your own.
Besides, I was going to take you to Tokyo with me anyway.
What!? But why?

What'd I tell you? You have to go to Tokyo and make that
concert a success.
That's Park-san's dream, my dream... and yours.
What good are dreams if you can't make them come true, right?

Plus, if you stay in Osaka, I get the feeling the Omi
Alliance won't be letting up any time soon.

I think you're safer in Kamurocho, where the Tojo Clan can
keep them in check.
All right. I'll go.
Phew. Good girl.
I made a promise to Park-san, after all.

I said I'd go in her place to meet her ex-husband the day
before the concert.

It won't be easy, of course... I'll have to tell him that
she's passed away.
Yeah... Okay. What do you say we get going?

If we take the Shinkansen to Tokyo, those Omi guys might be
waiting for us when we arrive.
I say we take a taxi.
Damn... Will you all give up already!
Kiryu-san. It's me, Daigo.
Daigo!? You're awake! How?
I'll explain later.
What you need to know now is it was never Kurosawa's goal to kill us or take over Kamurocho.
His real plan was to hand over the Tojo Clan and the Omi Alliance to someone else.
What!? To who?
No time right now. You've got to get to Tojo Clan headquarters as soon as possible.
You'll understand when you get there.
You got somewhere you need to be, Kiryu-san? Go. I'll be fine.
I still have to settle things with that freak Kanai, anyway.
And this is my town. I want to make them pay for what they've done to it. Just leave it all to me.
Maybe this'll make me into a town legend. What do you guys think?
I've been waiting for this, Kanai!
Dammit... Knew I should've quit smoking...
I wonder what Saejima-san and Shinada are up to.
Hello, Haruka-chan?
Horie-san? It's so early. Is something wrong?
Oh, Haruka-chan, it's horrible! You gotta come down to the office right away!
What? What happened!?
Well... I don't know how to tell you this...
Look, just get over here!

(What could've happened? I'd better get to the office
quickly!)

(Mmm, that was a good sleep. Okay, I'd better get to the
office for my lessons.)

Sorry to keep you waiting. I cleared my schedule for the
evening.
Are you all ready to go?
Haruka, are you ready to go now?
Fine. Do what you need to do. I'll be waiting right here.
Yes, I'm all ready.

Then, let's go. You've been working hard every day, and I'm
sure you must have built up some stress.

So tonight, we're going to go shopping and get rid of all
that. How does that sound?
(I guess Park-san isn't back yet.)
Sorry for the wait, Haruka, but I'm afraid I'm going to have to ask you to wait just a little longer.
I have a few things I need to take care of. I won't be long.

Hello, Haruka. The event in the park must've been quite an
experience for you.
But you really are coming along nicely.

I must say, it makes it a joy to teach you. Your former
instructor will be quite vexed, I'm sure.

Come see me at the studio any time you're ready for a
lesson.

Sorry to do this so out of the blue. Mind takin' a look at
the schedule board there?
A civic event?
So this just came in?

That's right. They're havin' a civic event in the park
nearby. Set up a special stage and everythin'.

The singer they booked caught a cold and lost her voice, so
they need a sub.
They asked us to find a replacement fast. You up for it?

If I'm bein' honest with ya, the location ain't the best. We
can't expect much of an audience.

I said that to Park-san, but she said it's important to just
get used to performin' on a stage.
No problem.

I'm afraid I'm all tied up here. Yamaura-san's already over
there waitin' for ya, though.
Sorry to ask, but do ya think you could hurry on over?
Excellent, Haruka! That was very nice!
That won't do, Haruka. You have to remember to stay focused.

Ah, Haruka-chan. Sorry to interrupt, but an urgent job just
came in.

When you get a sec, can you come to the office? I'll tell ya
all about it.

An urgent job? In that case, you'd better hurry along. We'll
stop the lesson here for now.
Good morning.
Morning, Haruka-chan.
Christina just got here, too. He should be in the studio.
Head on up when you're ready.
Excuse me... What happened here!?
Move along! We need to keep this area clear!
But I'm one of the talents here!
By "here" you mean Dyna Chair?

I see. Well, there's been a suicide here. Jumped off the
roof, apparently...
I'm sorry... It was the Dyna Chair president.
Did Park-san give any indication she was planning to commit suicide?

Not at all. One of our talents was just about to make her
big debut, so she was under some stress...
But I never thought she'd do anything like this.
This is Haruka Sawamura. She's a talent of ours.

Park-san was going to Tokyo today to make arrangements for
Haruka's debut event.
I see. I've got some questions for you later, if you don't mind.
Where's Park-san!?
Haruka-chan! Wait!
Park-san, please let me carry that.

No, that's all right. Now, what shall we do next? Is there
anywhere you'd like to go?
Well, let's see. Actually, I'd love to go to an arcade.

The kids at school are always talking about it, and it
sounds like so much fun.

An arcade? Yes, it might be a good chance to see what
other kids your age do. All right, then. Let's go.

All right. Let's go have some fun. We'll do a little
shopping first. Where do you usually buy clothes?

Clothes? I haven't really done any clothes shopping since
I've been here. I did buy a jacket at a department store,
though...

And you want to be a pop idol? Listen to me. Everything you
wear, eat, see, and hear is an important opportunity to
learn and grow.

Make it a goal to always be trying out the latest trends for
yourself and learn the classic styles that never go out of fashion.

That's the first step to becoming an idol, a "true icon" of
your time.

Good, that's what I like to hear. All right. Shall we make our
way to Le Marche, then? They have a wonderful selection.
Please wait for me at the office. I'll be there soon.
Do you think one of these would look nice on Park-san?
I think I'd like to look at these a little more.
Take your time. I'll take care of the drugstore thing and head back.
See you, then. Don't be too late, now.
Oh, good. I have enough.
Thank you. Will this be a gift?
I'll go get some wrapping paper, then.
Well, well. If it isn't little Haruka-chan.
What're you doing here?
Ugh! What a tacky-ass brooch! The hell were you thinking?
Cat got your tongue or something?
We're just asking what you're doing.
I was... buying Park-san a present.

Oh, okay! Now it all makes sense. That ugly brooch will be
perfect for her!
Hey, did you know that old hag had a failed singing career?
She made her debut, then crashed and burned before anyone even noticed her. Hilarious, right?

Do you really think somebody who couldn't make a name for
herself can do any better for you?
Don't tell me you actually think you stand a chance at winning the finals.

You ought to wake up and realize that you're really only
there to make us look good.

It's fixed, you know. I hear the producer Manda-san and our
agency already have an agreement.
You'd drop that agency if you had any sense.

Anywhere's got to be better than that washed-up wannabe's
pathetic little excuse for an agency, don't you think?
All done! You tired?
No, I'm all right.

Good answer! Because you gotta go downtown before goin'
back to the office.
Park-san sent Horie-kun out to buy something for her.
